title: WEVJ Dubai EV Charging Siting Reproducibility Archive
description: Public reported-output verification companion for the published World Electric Vehicle Journal article 'An Interaction-Aware NI-EA Framework for EV Charging-Station Siting: Source-Conditioned Robust Candidate Sets and Bounded Spatial Evidence in Dubai' (2026, 17(8), 411; DOI: 10.3390/wevj17080411). The archive supports inspection and verification of reuse-safe public-data screening and robustness-audit outputs against the Version of Record. It is not a claim of complete regeneration from every retained raw source layer and does not constitute demand validation, feeder-capacity validation, power-flow analysis, financial feasibility assessment, construction approval, or a final deployment plan.
